using JSON3, Base64
module GJ end
Base.include_string(GJ, String(base64decode("")))
using CUDA
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "jacc_array" => string(typeof(GJ.JACC.zeros(Float64, 2))), "rows" => Any[])
function mk(n)
    J = GJ.JACC
    b = J.array([1.0 + 0.5 * sin(1.7 * i + 0.3 * i * i) + 0.3 * cos(2.9 * i) for i in 1:n])
    z() = J.zeros(Float64, n); o() = J.zeros(Float64, 1)
    return (b = b, bb = z(), x = z(), xb = J.array([cos(0.37 * i) for i in 1:n]), r = z(), rb = z(), p = z(), pb = z(), Ap = z(), Apb = z(), rs = o(), rsb = o(), s = o(), sb = o(), t = o(), tb = o())
end
function run_adj(n, maxit)
    a = mk(n); st = GJ.initstacks_br_cg1d2_b_jacc(maxit, n); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync GJ.br_cg1d2_b_jacc(a.b, a.bb, a.x, a.xb, a.r, a.rb, a.p, a.pb, a.Ap, a.Apb, a.rs, a.rsb, a.s, a.sb, a.t, a.tb, n, maxit, 1.0e-300, 0.0, st...)
    return (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6
end
function run_pri(n, maxit)
    a = mk(n); CUDA.synchronize(); t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync GJ.br_cg1d2_jacc(a.b, a.x, a.r, a.p, a.Ap, a.rs, a.s, a.t, n, maxit, 1.0e-300)
    return (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6
end
for (n, maxit) in ((16, 8), (256, 32), (4096, 50), (65536, 50), (1048576, 50))
    row = Dict{String,Any}("n" => n, "maxit" => maxit)
    try
        for w in 1:2; run_adj(n, maxit); run_pri(n, maxit); end
        ba = Inf; bp = Inf
        for rep in 1:6; ba = min(ba, run_adj(n, maxit)); bp = min(bp, run_pri(n, maxit)); end
        row["adjoint_us_per_it"] = ba * 1e3 / maxit; row["primal_us_per_it"] = bp * 1e3 / maxit
    catch e
        row["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 400)
    end
    push!(res["rows"], row)
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
